keywords: The Petitioner sought revision of a High Court order discharging the accused from a bribery indictment under Section 20 of the Bribery Act. The High Court had held that securing the release of a suspect from the Magistrate’s Court was not a “benefit from the Government.” Held - such a discharge may result from decisions of government officials and therefore falls within the statutory provision. Application allowed.
legistation: Article 138 of the Constitution of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka; Section 364 of the Code of Criminal Procedure Act No. 15 of 1979
